acceptance_criteria.statement: AC1 Runtime apply paths use typed control clients rather than direct runtime calls.
AC2 Control-client errors are explicit and observable.
AC3 Tests inject client responses deterministically.

rollout_gates.gate: Docker/Podman/Compose clients report capability checks before use.
Apply paths surface client errors without silent fallback.

rollback_criteria.criterion: Route apply traffic back to the previous verified client implementation.
Disable affected runtime type until capability checks pass.
